data.user_prompt: What are the best white label voice AI agent platforms for agencies?

sections.text:
The best choice depends on whether you want a **ready-made reseller platform** or a **developer-controlled voice stack**. For most agencies, the strongest shortlist is **Autocalls, Trillet, Synthflow, Stammer AI, VoiceAIWrapper, and Retell/Vapi**.

| Platform | Best for | White-label model | Main strengths | Main tradeoff |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| **Autocalls** | Fast agency launch | Full branded platform | Client subaccounts, custom branding, Stripe billing, voice plus WhatsApp/chat; its white-label plan is listed at $419/month with 3,500 minutes and $0.09/minute overage.[1] | Less control than building on a lower-level API |
| **Trillet** | Finished voice-AI reseller service | Full branded platform | Agency plan includes unlimited workspaces, custom domain, branded email, markup controls, and 3,000 AI minutes for $299/month; telephony is separate.[2] | Primarily voice-focused; pricing and included minutes should be verified before committing |
| **Synthflow** | Mature no-code voice workflows | Full agency/enterprise offering | Strong visual builder and suited to agencies managing sophisticated call flows; it is positioned for larger enterprise voice deployments.[3] | Can be expensive, with enterprise contracts reportedly starting around $30,000 annually.[3] |
| **Stammer AI** | Voice plus chat resale at lower cost | Full white-label platform | Client subaccounts, separate wallets, and agency resale features; published agency pricing varies by plan and source, from roughly $99 to $197/month.[1][2] | Validate exact current limits, branding features, and voice-minute costs |
| **VoiceAIWrapper** | Agencies already using Vapi, Retell, or ElevenLabs | White-label wrapper | Lets agencies retain provider choice while adding branded portals, client accounts, rebilling, and campaign tools.[4] | You manage two layers: the wrapper plus the underlying voice provider |
| **Retell AI** | Natural conversations at scale | API-based, build-your-own | Strong voice runtime and natural phone conversations; reported usage starts around $0.07/minute.[1] | Not a turnkey reseller portal; requires building the agency SaaS layer |
| **Vapi** | Developer-led agencies | API-based, build-your-own | Maximum control over models, telephony, tools, and product experience; reported platform pricing is about $0.05/minute plus provider costs.[1] | Requires engineering, monitoring, billing, and support infrastructure |

## Best picks by agency type

- **Best overall for a fast launch:** **Autocalls**—particularly if you want built-in client billing, subaccounts, and a packaged voice-plus-messaging offer.[1]
- **Best finished white-label voice platform:** **Trillet**—a strong fit when branded workspaces, custom domains, and predictable agency packaging matter most.[2]
- **Best for sophisticated call flows:** **Synthflow**—better suited to agencies selling higher-value implementations rather than low-cost SMB packages.[3]
- **Best budget-friendly voice-and-chat option:** **Stammer AI**, provided its current plan limits and usage pricing fit your margins.[2]
- **Best for technical agencies:** **Retell AI or Vapi**—use these when you want to own the customer experience and build your own portal, billing, and orchestration layer.[1]
- **Best for multi-provider flexibility:** **VoiceAIWrapper**—useful when you want to switch between or combine upstream providers without exposing them to clients.[4]

## What to evaluate before choosing

- **True white labeling:** custom domain, email, login page, mobile branding, and removal of vendor references.
- **Client management:** separate workspaces, permissions, usage caps, phone numbers, analytics, and call recordings.
- **Billing:** Stripe rebilling, prepaid wallets, usage-based markups, and whether the platform adds hidden per-minute fees.
- **Voice economics:** distinguish AI-minute charges from telephony, transcription, LLM, and carrier costs.
- **Call quality:** test interruption handling, latency, barge-in, transfers, voicemail detection, and accents.
- **Compliance:** recording consent, TCPA obligations for US outbound calls, data retention, PII controls, and HIPAA availability if relevant.
- **Portability:** confirm whether you can export prompts, call data, numbers, workflows, and integrations if you change vendors.

**Practical recommendation:** start with **Autocalls or Trillet** for a turnkey agency offer; choose **Synthflow** for enterprise-grade visual orchestration; choose **Vapi or Retell** only if your team can build and maintain the surrounding SaaS infrastructure. Verify pricing directly with each vendor because agency plans, included minutes, and white-label terms change frequently.[1][2][3]
